annotations.title: Quote a medical chronology by page count

description: Computes the price of a Zicron medical chronology from the approximate page count of the record set, using the published list price, and returns the breakdown (base price, pages over the included amount, first-case discount, total) and the turnaround. Deterministic; read-only; no side effects and nothing is ordered. Use this when a user asks what a chronology for N pages would cost. The result is an estimate: Zicron confirms the page count and price in writing before any work starts.

first_case.description: True if this would be the requester's first case with Zicron (first case is half price).

pages.description: Approximate total number of pages in the medical record set.

name: quote_chronology

error.description: Present only when isError is true: why the call was refused and what to do next.

useInstead.description: Another tool or route, when one fits.

firm.description: Always false: an estimate, confirmed in writing before work starts.

first_case.description: Whether the first-case discount was applied.

first_case_total.description: What the total would be as a first case (half price), USD.

ignored_fields.description: Argument names that were not used.

included_pages.description: Pages included in the per-case price.

offer_version.description: Price list version that produced the quote.

overage_price.description: Pages over the included amount times the per-page rate, USD.

pages_over_included.description: Pages billed at the per-page rate.

turnaround_hours.description: Turnaround once the complete record set is uploaded.

title: Quote a medical chronology by page count
